title: Brick wall segment
description: Small running-bond brick wall segment used as a refine reference package — attach its mesh and photo to project a brick pattern onto a model's surface.
prompt: Recreate this small running-bond brick wall segment as parametric KCL. Prefer a compact grid (about 3 courses × 3–4 bricks) of individual bricks with recessed mortar joints — keep brick length, height, depth, and joint width editable. Avoid huge pattern counts so Engine export stays reliable.
